entry: Eigenvectors finally clicked: they're the directions a transformation only stretches. Now I see why PCA uses them.
Visualised matrix multiplication as composing linear transformations. A lot less mysterious now.
Wrote vector and matrix ops in plain Python before touching NumPy, just to prove I understand them.
Started linear algebra. Vectors as arrows, vectors as lists, and how the two views connect.
Finished the algebra block: polynomials, logarithms, exponentials. Marked it complete on the tree.
Read an intro on how EEG electrodes pick up neural activity. Bookmarked it for when I get there.
Refreshed Python fundamentals: comprehensions, generators, type hints.
Day one. Mapped the path from Python to brain-computer interfaces and started this log.
